1 · Feed It

Add one or more sources. The Grinder gets the full transcript or text, saves it, and (unless you choose "transcript only") grinds it down to its substance and compares it with your library.

Link

Video links (YouTube, X, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram) are transcribed automatically. You can paste several links, one per line.

File

Drop files here or tap to choose
PDF · EPUB · DOCX · TXT · MD · HTML · audio (MP3, M4A, WAV) · short video

Paste

2 · The Substance

Green border = kept. Tap Keep / Drop to change, then save. NEW, ADDS TO and CONFLICTS are kept by default.

Your Library

Every kept idea, with its source. This is what new material is compared against.

Take It to Claude

Downloads one file for the project above. In claude.ai, open that project, add the file to its Files (or Project knowledge), and every chat in that project can use it.

Keys

Keys are stored only in this browser on this device. Each is sent only to its own service (Anthropic, Supadata, OpenAI), never to MarketLights or anyone else.

Your Focus

Tell the Grinder what you care about, so it judges what is useful to you. Example: “The Mental Architect: mindset, psychology, persuasion, YouTube growth. Universum Media: utility websites, SEO, AdSense, AI tools.”
